{{Top|leg}}
'''Storage tank fourteen''' was a [[Fuel/Legends|fueling]] tank near fueling [[Fuel City|station six]], in the [[City/Legends|city]] [[Fuel City]], which was located on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Sulon/Legends|Sulon]]. Along with several other tanks, it was destroyed by [[Jan Ors]], prompting air-traffic controller [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Zyak]] to desert his post and leave the inexperienced [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Nomo]] in charge.
